correctness.rationale: Uniqueness of the John ellipsoid and the two disk-hull reflections force center 0 and axes (a,b,b). Exact support minimization reduces full inclusion to b^2<=1/2 and a^2+t(t+2)b^2<=(1+t/2)^2. The strictly concave log-volume maximization of b^2 sqrt(a^2) yields the stated two branches including t=0 and matching t=1. Derivative of volume branch (t+2)^2/t establishes t=2 minimum. Separately sampled 450,000 directions for t=0,0.01,0.25,0.8,1,1.2,2,4,12: every support margin nonnegative (minimum 4.75e-8); the analytic inequality, not sampling, proves all directions.
